# Canada.ca

> Canada.ca is the official Government of Canada portal providing unified access to federal services, programs, and information across employment, social development, defence, research, and economic initiatives.

Canada.ca serves as the primary digital gateway for Canadian citizens and businesses to access government services including employment insurance, pensions, benefits, defence procurement oversight, research funding, and interprovincial trade information. The site maintains both English and French versions to serve Canada's bilingual population.

## Key Topics

- Employment and Social Development
- One Canadian Economy Act
- Labour Mobility
- Interprovincial Trade
- Defence Acquisition
- Intelligence Commissioner
- Research Funding Ecosystem
- Benefits and Pensions
- Government Transparency
- Accessibility Standards
- Privacy and Access to Information
- Canadian Armed Forces
- Treasury Board
- Military Procurement

## Core Government Services

- [Home - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en.html): Government of Canada main portal providing access to all services and information
- [Accueil - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/fr.html): French-language homepage for Government of Canada services and information
- [Employment and Social Development Canada - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/employment-social-development.html): ESDC main portal for employment, benefits, pensions, and social programs

## Economic Integration and Trade

- [One Canadian Economy - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/one-canadian-economy.html): One Canadian Economy initiative covering trade, labour mobility, and major projects
- [Free Trade and Labour Mobility in Canada Act - One Canadian Economy - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/one-canadian-economy/services/free-trade-labour-mobility-canada-act.html): Information on Free Trade and Labour Mobility in Canada Act (Bill C-5)
- [Frequently asked questions about the One Canadian Economy Act - One Canadian Economy - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/one-canadian-economy/services/answers-top-questions-about-one-canadian-economy-act.html): FAQ on One Canadian Economy Act covering trade barriers and labour mobility

## Defence and Security Oversight

- [Independent Review Panel for Defence Acquisition - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/independent-review-panel-defence-acquisition.html): Overview of Independent Review Panel for Defence Acquisition and mandate
- [Mandate of the Independent Review Panel for Defence Acquisition - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/independent-review-panel-defence-acquisition/corporate/mandate.html): Mandate and authority of Independent Review Panel for Defence Acquisition
- [Independent Review Panel for Defence Acquisition Annual Reports - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/independent-review-panel-defence-acquisition/services/annual-reports.html): Annual reports on defence procurement observations from Independent Review Panel
- [Cybersecurity Authorization - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/intelligence-commissioner/oversight-en/cybersecurity.html): CSE cybersecurity authorization oversight and ministerial authorization details

## Research and Innovation

- [Canada's research funding ecosystem - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/research-coordinating-committee/priorities/equity-diversity-inclusion-research.html): Canada Research Coordinating Committee position on EDI in research funding
- [Strengthening equity, diversity and inclusion in research - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/research-coordinating-committee/priorities/equity-diversity-inclusion-research.html): Canada Research Coordinating Committee position on EDI in research funding

## Standards, Accessibility, and Transparency

- [Accessibility Standards Canada](https://www.canada.ca/en/accessibility-standards-canada.html): Accessibility Standards Canada organization overview and standards development
- [Access to Information and Privacy - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/intelligence-commissioner/transparency/atip-annualreport.html): Annual reports on Access to Information and Privacy Act compliance
- [Notes for Remarks to the Standing Committee on Public Safety and National Security - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/intelligence-commissioner/notesforremarsktothesecu.html): Intelligence Commissioner remarks on Bill C-70 and CSE oversight to Parliament
- [Accessibility - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/intelligence-commissioner/accessibility.html): Intelligence Commissioner accessibility plan and barrier removal progress

## Social Programs and Support

- [Programs and initiatives for seniors - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/employment-social-development/corporate/seniors.html): Seniors programs, caregiver benefits, and financial assistance information
- [Contracting Information for Suppliers - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/employment-social-development/corporate/contracting.html): ESDC supplier contracting information and government procurement guidelines

## Optional

- [Terms and conditions - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/transparency/terms.html): Legal terms, copyright information, and permissions for Canada.ca content
- [Avis - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/fr/transparence/avis.html): French legal notices, copyright, and website policies for Canada.ca
